name: Bright Data
tagline: Enterprise web data platform for scraping, SERP, and browser automation at scale
description: Bright Data provides enterprise-grade web data collection APIs including Web Scraper API, SERP API, Web Unlocker, and Scraping Browser for reliable public web data extraction with proxy infrastructure, anti-bot handling, and structured datasets.

auth.details: API token (Bearer) or zone credentials; self-serve account signup. Common pattern: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY on REST endpoints.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 5,000 free credits/month (~$7.50) shared across Web Unlocker, SERP, Web Scraper API, and Scraper Studio; no credit card required. Unfunded free-tier accounts capped at 1,000 req/min (SERP/Unlocker/Proxy). Proxies and Browser API excluded from monthly free credits (separate one-time trial credits).

rate_limits: Free tier (unfunded): 1,000 requests/min across SERP API, Web Unlocker API, and Proxy products (removed once funds added). Web Scraper API documents concurrent-job limits (e.g. up to 5,000 concurrent jobs; Discovery batch up to 100). Paid/general RPM is often zone/account-specific rather than a single public global number.
use_cases: scrape a product page with anti-bot bypass
run a SERP query for keyword rankings
unlock blocked public pages via residential proxies
extract structured e-commerce data at scale
